q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Sales did not drop — net sales on 2026-10-13 were ₹91,220 vs ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12 (+127.4%), so yesterday was a strong day rather than a decline.

What changed (by impact)
- Orders and volume: Orders rose 26.00 → 45.00 (+73.1%), units sold 27 → 61 (+125.9%). More orders are the largest contributor to the sales move.  
- Average order value: Net AOV increased ₹1,543 → ₹2,027 (+31.3%), so higher baskets amplified the rise.  
- Ad spend and traffic moved together: Ad spend rose ₹38,661 → ₹50,442 (+30.5%) and sessions were similar-to-higher; these co-moved with sales but the data does not establish causation.  
- Returns / refunds: Product refunded amount (ex-GST) on 2026-10-13 was ₹61,171 (noted large) — however the diagnosis did not find refunds to be a supported cause once trends and weekday effects were controlled.

Confidence and interpretation
- The change is within the metric's normal range and the diagnostic engine found no single supported causal driver (orders and AOV are the arithmetic levers that explain the increase; ad spend and sessions correlate but are not proved causes).  
Worth checking: campaign-level shifts called out by the diagnostic (campaigns named TH-383-SUSPENDER-... dropped to zero and a specific ad TH-471-PLAYSCRATCHLOUNGE_IMG_6516 appeared with ~₹24,962) — drill into campaigns/ads next to confirm whether creative / budget edits explain the traffic mix.
